title: Nanna's Baked Beans 'n' Mash
subtitle: with Vegan Cheddar
description: It’s plant power all the way with our super-tasty vegan dishes! Our meat-free, dairy-free, honey-free dishes are amped with plant-based proteins, fresh produce, nuts and seeds. Best of all, they’re for everyone, whether you're vegan, vegetarian or flexitarian.

steps.text: Mash potato: Peel the potatoes and cut into 3cm chunks. Put the potato in a medium saucepan, cover with cold salted water and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat to medium and cook for 14 mins or until tender. Drain and return to the pan. Mash the potato until smooth. Add 10g plant-based butter and 1 tbs plant-based milk, season with salt and pepper and stir to combine.

Prep ingredients: Meanwhile, coarsely chop the broccoli stem, then cut the head into small florets. Drain and rinse the beans. Crumble 1 stock cube into a medium saucepan, add 180ml (¾ cup) boiling water and stir to dissolve. Add the tomato paste, country seasoning and 1 tbs tomato sauce and stir to combine.

Cook baked beans: Add the beans to the stock mixture and bring to the boil. Season with pepper. Reduce the heat to medium and cook, stirring occasionally, for 8 mins or until thickened. Remove the pan from the heat. Taste, then season with pepper.

Microwave broccoli: While the beans are cooking, put the broccoli in a microwave-safe bowl and season with salt and pepper. Cover and microwave for 3-4 mins until tender (see Make it yours). Add 10g plant-based butter and stir until melted and combined.
Serve up: Divide the mashed potato, baked beans and broccoli among plates. Scatter with the vegan cheddar and enjoy!
Make it yours: Don't have a microwave? Cook the broccoli in a saucepan of boiling water until tender instead.
